## Engagements
- Discovery sprint: €4,500, up to two weeks, bounded decision brief.
- Focused build: from €18,000, typically four to six weeks, defined release.
- Delivery partnership: from €24,000/month, initial three-month engagement.
- Fractional AI / CTO leadership: from €7,500/month, defined mandate and capacity.
Prices exclude VAT where applicable. Final scope and fees are agreed in writing. Production hosting and model usage are separate.

## Attribution
Founder career experience is not agency client work. Work-page briefs are illustrative. No agency certifications, guaranteed ROI, autonomous staffing equivalents or client results are claimed.
